```yaml
name: Advanced Translation Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - '**/*.arb'
      - '.github/scripts/translate_toolkit_check.py'
      - '.github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py'
      - '.github/TRANSLATION_CHECK_PROMPT.md'

jobs:
  translation-quality-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install translate-toolkit
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install gettext

      - name: Run Translate Toolkit checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/translate_toolkit_check.py

      - name: Run Advanced Translation checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py

      - name: Validate ARB files format
        run: |
          find . -name "*.arb" -exec sh -c 'echo "Checking {}"; cat {} | python -m json.tool > /dev/null && echo "✓ Valid JSON" || echo "✗ Invalid JSON"' \;

      - name: Report results
        run: |
          echo "Translation quality checks completed successfully."
```
